title: The Dual-Server Domination Number of Some Graph Operations
summary: A subset $S \subseteq V(G)$ is called a dual-server dominating set if there exists a partition $π_S=\{R,B\}$ of $S$ such that every vertex in $V(G)\setminus S$ has at least one neighbour in $R$ and at least one neighbour in $B.$ The minimum cardinality of a DS-dominating set of $G$ is called the dual-server domination number, denoted by $γ_{ds}(G)$. In this paper, we investigate the dual-server domination number of several graph operations.
